scene.speaker: valentina
scene.bubble: Once upon a time, the Fjord Club went to the zoo. Erik, which animal do you want to see first?
scene.intro: The gates of the zoo open at nine, and the Fjord Club is first in line! Valentina wants to see the pandas eating their breakfast of bamboo, Erik brings a notebook to draw every animal, and Sofia has the map with all the paths. Which animal is bigger, a whale or a dolphin? Which one jumps higher, a kangaroo or a frog? Today we compare them all — and Luna waits at home, dreaming of a very big bone.

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the animals.

words.clue: A clever grey animal that jumps out of the sea.
A big yellow cat. It is the king of the jungle.
A black and white bear that eats bamboo.
A black and white bird that swims but can't fly.
The biggest animal in the sea.

activities.title: Match the animal with its special skill.
Listen. Valentina tells Erik about the zoo. Write a word in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Valentina (narradora, cálida) y Erik (inventor, curioso).
data.script: Erik: Valentina, tell me about the zoo! … Valentina: It was great! First we saw the pandas. They were eating bamboo. … Erik: How many pandas were there? … Valentina: Two! A big one and a baby. … Erik: And what was your favourite animal? … Valentina: The dolphins! They jumped very high, higher than the fence! … Erik: Wow! Did you see the penguins? … Valentina: Yes, they were swimming in cold blue water. … Erik: I want to go too. Can we take Luna? … Valentina: No dogs at the zoo, Erik! Luna can wait at home with a big bone.
